results.title: Debt Payoff Planner Spreadsheet Snowball Avalanche Calculator Excel Google Sheets Debt Tracker Credit Card Payoff Debt Free Planner
results.description:
Works in Excel and Google Sheets — and there's a full printable planner too.

**What's your debt-free date?** Most people paying minimums couldn't tell you. This kit calculates it — under BOTH payoff methods — and shows you exactly how much interest the better method saves you.

The **Debt-Free Fast Track Kit** is a debt payoff planner spreadsheet with a snowball vs avalanche calculator built in, plus a 20-page printable debt & emergency fund planner for the pen-and-paper version of the same plan.

### The spreadsheet (Excel + Google Sheets, 6 sheets)
- **Start Here & Setup** — 5-step setup, currency selector ($ / £ / €), colour key
- **Debt Inventory** — up to 15 debts: balance, APR, minimum payment, due day. Total debt, total minimums and your weighted average APR calculate automatically
- **Snowball vs Avalanche Comparator** — enter ONE extra monthly payment. The sheet ranks your debts both ways and shows, side by side: your debt-free date for each method, total interest for each, the interest saved by the better method, and months saved. This is the screen that changes how you see your debt
- **Month-by-Month Payoff Schedule** — up to 60 months. Every debt gets its minimum, your extra payment attacks debt #1, and when a debt clears its payment automatically rolls onto the next one (the roll-down does the heavy lifting)
- **Payment Log & Balance Check-In** — log real payments against your statement balances and see instantly whether you're ahead of or behind plan
- **Emergency Fund & Sinking Funds** — the $500 → $1,000 starter-fund ladder, up to 6 sinking funds/goals with monthly-amount-needed calculated, and a full 52-week savings challenge tracker ($1,378 in a year)

Fictional sample data is pre-filled so you can see every formula working the moment you open it — just type over the yellow cells with your own numbers. Type in yellow cells only; everything else calculates itself.

### The printable planner (20 pages — US Letter AND A4 included)
Cover · Start Here · My Money Snapshot · Debt Inventory (2 pages) · Snowball Worksheet · Avalanche Worksheet · My Payoff Decision · Monthly Payoff Plan · Payment Log · Credit Card Payoff Tracker · Debt Progress Thermometer (colour-in) · Milestone Map · Find Extra Money (cuts + subscription audit) · No-Spend Challenge (30 days) · First $1,000 Emergency Fund Tracker · Sinking Funds Planner · Savings Challenges Menu (52-week, reverse 52-week, 100-envelope $5,050, round-up) · Monthly Money Check-In · My Debt-Free Plan on a Page

### Why this kit
- Two methods, one honest answer: see the real interest difference for YOUR debts, then choose — avalanche for least interest, snowball for quick wins that keep you going
- The emergency-fund ladder is built in, so one surprise bill can't push you back onto a card
- No app, no subscription, no account — buy once, use until you're debt-free
- Spreadsheet + printable together: the calculator for the numbers, the paper for the fridge door

What's Included (the ZIP you download)
- Debt-Payoff-Planner-Spreadsheet.xlsx — 6 sheets, works in Excel, Google Sheets & LibreOffice
- Debt-Free-Fast-Track-Kit-Printable-US-Letter.pdf — 20 pages
- Debt-Free-Fast-Track-Kit-Printable-A4.pdf — 20 pages
- Start-Here.pdf — 1-page quick-start guide
- Instant digital download after purchase

Frequently asked questions

Is this a physical product?
No — it's an instant digital download. Nothing is shipped. Print the planner at home or at any print shop, and open the spreadsheet on your computer, tablet or phone.

Do I need Excel?
No. The spreadsheet works in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets (free — upload the file to Google Drive and open it) and LibreOffice (free). Every formula works in all three.

How does the snowball vs avalanche calculator work?
Enter your debts once (balance, APR, minimum payment), then enter one extra monthly payment. The sheet ranks your debts smallest-balance-first (snowball) and highest-APR-first (avalanche), runs both plans month by month, and shows each debt-free date, each total interest, and how much the better method saves you. Pick a method and the full 60-month schedule rebuilds itself.

How can I pay off debt faster?
Pay more than the minimum on ONE debt at a time while paying minimums on the rest, and when that debt clears, roll its whole payment onto the next one. That's exactly what this kit automates — the schedule shows the roll-down happening month by month, and the Find Extra Money and No-Spend Challenge pages help you find a bigger extra payment.

Are the debt-free dates and interest figures exact?
No — they are estimates, and the kit says so wherever they appear. Estimates assume your APR stays the same (monthly interest = balance × APR ÷ 12), you pay the same amount every month, and you add no new charges. Your actual results will differ as rates, balances and life change. This kit is a planning and education tool, not financial advice.

I'm not in the US — will it work for me?
Yes. Pick $ / £ / € in the setup, and print the A4 version of the planner. The maths (APR, minimums, roll-down) works the same everywhere.

Can I print the planner more than once?
Yes — print fresh copies every month, as many as you need for your own household.

Can I share or resell the files?
No — personal use only, please.

What if I get stuck?
Message us before leaving a review — because it's a digital file we can't accept returns the usual way, but we'll always try to help you get it working. The Start Here sheet inside the spreadsheet walks through every step.

DIGITAL DOWNLOAD — no physical item will be shipped.
After purchase, Etsy will give you a download link (also sent by email). Download the ZIP, unzip it, open the spreadsheet in Excel or Google Sheets, and print the PDF at 100% scale. Colours may vary slightly depending on your printer/screen.

🍪 NORDIC COOKIE EXCHANGE PARTY KIT - FIVE COORDINATED THEMES

Host a coordinated Christmas cookie exchange with five Nordic printable themes. Each theme includes an invitation, sign-up sheet, labels, recipe cards, voting slips, awards and a host checklist. Only the six text fields in each invitation are digitally editable; the remaining party forms are fixed printables with handwriting areas.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE

Five themed customer ZIP files containing 17 distinct PDFs across the bundle:

• 5 editable 5 x 7 inch invitation PDFs - one per theme.
• 10 printable 15-page party packs - each theme in A4 and US Letter.
• 2 four-page printing and hosting guides - A4 and US Letter.
• Read-me instructions and a nonexclusive licence.

The same guides are included in each theme ZIP for convenience. A4 and US Letter are alternate page sizes, not additional designs. All customer files are free of logos and watermarks.

DIGITAL PRODUCT ONLY - no physical item will be shipped.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FIVE COLLECTIONS, SEVEN USEFUL COMPONENTS

1. Hygge Cookie Table - sage, ivory and cinnamon; buns, baking tools and folk ceramics.
2. Cranberry Folk Cookie Swap - cranberry, evergreen and ivory; folk hearts, iced cookies and festive baking details.
3. Fjord Winter Fika - dusty blue, silver sage and ivory; botanical coffee ware and snowflake cookies.
4. Gingerbread Cottage Gathering - gingerbread brown, oatmeal and evergreen; cottages, cinnamon and icing hearts.
5. Nordic Bakery Ledger - muted teal, terracotta and cream; coffee pots, pastries and wheat sprigs.

Every theme includes:

• Invitation: 5 x 7 inches, with six fillable text fields.
• Sign-up sheet: baker, cookie name, quantity and notes columns.
• Six numbered cookie-label variants: 3.5 x 2 inch flat cards and matching folded tents. The tent is 3.5 x 4 inches before folding. Flat and folded formats use the same six label designs.
• Two recipe-card layouts: 6 x 4 inch fronts with matching method backs.
• Voting slip: 3 x 4 inches, four repeat slips on its print sheet.
• Six 5 x 7 inch award cards: Best Tasting, Best Decorated, Most Festive, Most Creative, Best Family Recipe and Crowd Favourite.
• Host checklist: planning, invitations, preparation, voting and take-home shares, with a simple cookie quantity planner.

Across all five themes, that is 30 numbered cookie-label variants in two formats, 10 recipe-card front/back layouts and 30 themed award cards. Decorative artwork is coordinated within each theme; this is a stationery kit, not a standalone clipart collection.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📥 HOW TO DOWNLOAD YOUR FILES

1. Open Etsy.com in a web browser and sign in. Downloads are not available through the Etsy app.
2. Go to Your account → Purchases and reviews (Purchases).
3. Select Download Files next to your order after payment confirmation.
If you checked out as a guest, use the download link in your Etsy receipt email.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💻 DOWNLOAD, EDIT AND PRINT

1. Download all five ZIP files and extract them on your computer.
2. Choose a theme and open the A4 or US Letter print pack.
3. To type your invitation details, open the separate Editable Invitation PDF in a desktop PDF form editor. Save a copy and reopen it to check the entries.
4. Print only the needed pages at Actual size / 100%.
5. Cut solid outlines and fold cookie tents along their dashed centre lines. Write on the remaining forms by hand.

Only invitation text is digitally editable: host, date, time, location, RSVP and what to bring. The decorative artwork, fonts, colours and layout are fixed. The other party forms have handwriting areas and are not fillable templates.

Keep invitation entries short: host up to 36 characters, date and time up to 28, and location, RSVP and what to bring up to 44. Embedded Geist is the invitation's default form font. Viewer behaviour can vary, especially in browser or mobile apps; use a desktop form editor and review your saved copy before printing. No Canva link, layered source file, SVG or editable artwork is included.

Recipe fronts and backs are supplied on separate sheets for manual pairing. Automatic duplex alignment is not promised. Use paper or light card suitable for your printer and follow the included guide.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📜 PERSONAL AND COMMERCIAL USE

YOU MAY use the kit for personal parties, share a completed invitation privately with your invited guests, and sell finished physical printed stationery made from these PDF layouts. Rights are nonexclusive.

YOU MAY NOT resell or redistribute digital PDFs, blank invitations, templates or extracted artwork, share customer files publicly, or claim exclusive ownership. Seller mockups, photographs, videos and design resources are excluded from the customer licence. Full terms are included in Licence.txt.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PLEASE NOTE

This is an English-language digital stationery bundle. Cookies, coffee, decorations, envelopes, boxes and other physical mockup props are presentation examples and are not included. Sample invitation details shown in marketing are examples; customer invitation fields are blank.

Colours can vary between screens, printers and paper. Layout dimensions and digital PDF rendering were checked; no physical print test was performed. Ingredient/allergen areas are for baker-provided notes and do not certify food safety.

Decorative illustrations were created with AI assistance under DigiPatternLab's creative direction. DigiPatternLab prepared the coordinated layouts, editable invitation fields, print sheets, instructions and final files.
